articles.summary: DELRAY BEACH, Fla., Sept. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - PetMed Express, Inc., dba PetMeds and parent company of PetCareRx (Nasdaq: PETS), today announced the appointment of Andrew Parry as Chief Technology Officer, effective immediately. Parry will lead the Company's technology strategy, platform architecture and engineering execution across its e-commerce, pharmacy and enterprise systems. Parry brings more than three decades of technology leadership experience and joins PetMeds from The ODP Corporation, where he most recently served as Senior Vice President and Chief Information Officer, leading technology for the retail, business solutions and supply-chain units. In that role, he executed a multi-year initiative to embed generative AI and workflow automation across the business and led platform-modernization efforts including e-commerce and order-management. articles.title: PetMeds Appoints Andrew Parry as Chief Technology Officer
